facts.text: I am thinking of organizing a farm sale to get rid of excess eggs.
I want to make some space in the fridge by selling excess eggs.
I have regular customers who buy our eggs every week.
I am thinking of offering a discount to regular customers who buy our eggs every week.
I need to order more layer feed soon.
I am wondering how long 50 pounds of layer feed lasts for five hens.
I am thinking of selling cheese I've been making from our goat milk at the farm sale.
I remember it took me and my brother three hours to assemble our new chicken coop.
I assembled our new chicken coop in February.
I am thinking of setting up a small table with samples of our cheese and eggs at the farm sale.
I want people to taste the cheese and eggs before they buy.
I am thinking of putting a small sign on the table that says "New Chicken Coop - Delivered February 10th!"
I am thinking of adding a personal touch with the sign.
I want the sign to give customers an idea of our farm's recent updates.
I am thinking of putting pictures of our farm and animals around the table.
I want the pictures to create a more immersive experience for customers.
